mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_note WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM t_note WHERE author_id=#{author} AND id<#{before} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{size}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_note SET title=#{title},body=#{body},status=#{status},revision=revision+1,version=version+1,reject_reason=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM t_note WHERE id>#{after} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_note WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PUBLISHED'

SELECT n.id,n.author_id,n.title,n.published_at,(SELECT media_id FROM t_note_media nm WHERE nm.note_id=n.id ORDER BY position LIMIT 1) AS cover_media_id,cover.media_type AS cover_media_type,cover.duration_ms, u.avatar_media_id AS author_avatar_media_id,u.nickname AS author_name,COALESCE(m.like_count,0) AS like_count,COALESCE(m.favorite_count,0) AS favorite_count,COALESCE(m.comment_count,0) AS comment_count,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM t_follow f WHERE f.follower_id=#{user} AND f.followee_id=n.author_id) AS following,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM t_note_topic nt JOIN t_interest i ON i.topic_id=nt.topic_id WHERE nt.note_id=n.id AND i.user_id=#{user} AND i.mode='LIKE') AS interest,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM t_note_topic nt JOIN t_interest i ON i.topic_id=nt.topic_id WHERE nt.note_id=n.id AND i.user_id=#{user} AND i.mode='REDUCE') AS reduced FROM t_note n JOIN t_user u ON u.id=n.author_id LEFT JOIN t_note_metric m ON m.note_id=n.id LEFT JOIN t_note_media first_media ON first_media.note_id=n.id AND first_media.position=1 LEFT JOIN t_media cover ON cover.id=first_media.media_id WHERE n.status='PUBLISHED' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM t_hidden_note h WHERE h.note_id=n.id AND h.user_id=#{user}) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM t_follow f WHERE f.follower_id=#{user} AND f.followee_id=n.author_id) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM t_note_topic nt JOIN t_topic t ON t.id=nt.topic_id WHERE nt.note_id=n.id AND t.category=#{category}) AND (n.title LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR n.body LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!' OR u.nickname LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '!') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM t_note_topic nt WHERE nt.note_id=n.id AND nt.topic_id=#{topic}) AND n.author_id=#{author} ORDER BY n.published_at DESC,n.id DESC LIMIT 300
SELECT n.id FROM t_note n WHERE n.status='PUBLISHED' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM t_hidden_note h WHERE h.user_id=#{user} AND h.note_id=n.id) AND n.id IN #{id}

SELECT * FROM (SELECT n.id AS subject_id,n.title AS label,'LIKE' AS metric,COALESCE(m.like_count,0) AS value,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY COALESCE(m.like_count,0) DESC,n.id DESC) AS position FROM t_note n LEFT JOIN t_note_metric m ON m.note_id=n.id WHERE n.status='PUBLISHED'n.author_id=#{author} AND n.status<>'DELETED') ranked WHERE position>#{offset} ORDER BY position LIMIT #{size}
